status: Active replacement for the large sweep; pilot only initially
stages: One validation-only pilot; diagnose rather than sweep if it fails
Four symbolic one-seed size-screen runs after pilot gate passes; require validation and independent source IID mastery before transfer interpretation
Two additional source-format runs at the smallest screened successful size; source mastery required for each
Additional seeds only for key successful conditions; separate approval/review before expansion
selection: Minimum validation loss within each run; smallest tested size passing validation and symbolic IID gate for transfer follow-up
interpretation: Exploratory redesign after full-corpus failures. One-seed screening does not establish a reliable or universal threshold. Compact task changes distractor density and symbol pool, so old and new runs are not a controlled capacity comparison.
